# (a) The most-used second-hand marketplace in each EU country

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate_marketplace_doc.py — edit
     backend/ufeu/data/marketplaces.yaml instead. -->

Catalogue version 1, last reviewed 2026-08-21. 
64 marketplaces across 27 member states plus the pan-EU players.

**How to read this.** Rank 1 is what locals reach for first. *Searched by
default* means the app queries it on every search; the rest are one toggle
away. *Confidence* is how sure we are of the "most used" claim — medium and
low entries are worth re-checking before you trust them. *Engine* `manual`
means the site is deliberately not automated (bot protection or terms of
service) and the app gives you a deep search link instead.

## Pan-European

**1. [eBay (EU sites)](https://www.ebay.de)** — `ebay_browse` · high confidence · **searched by default** · ships to PT · needs credentials

> The only large EU marketplace with a first-class, documented, free public search API. Nine EU sites (DE/FR/IT/ES/IE/NL/AT/BE/PL) behind one call, and "used" is a real filter rather than a guess. Start here.

*Shipping:* eBay International Shipping / seller-declared EU shipping. Filter by "ships to PT" in the UI.

*Account:* Free developer account, self-service. Create a production keyset, then `ufeu accounts set ebay --client-id ... --client-secret ...`. No scraping, no ToS grey zone, ~5000 calls/day on the default tier.

**1. [Vinted (EU pool)](https://www.vinted.pt)** — `vinted` · high confidence · **searched by default** · ships to PT

> #1 second-hand app by MAU in FR/PT/ES/IT/LT and top-3 in most of the rest of the EU. Crucially, Vinted runs *connected country pools*: one query against vinted.pt already returns sellers across the Iberian/EU pool, so a single endpoint covers most of Europe. The per-country entries below exist for catalogue completeness and are disabled by default to avoid duplicate hits.

*Shipping:* Best-in-class. Vinted's integrated shipping covers PT natively (CTT, DPD, Vinted Go lockers) and cross-border inside the connected pool, with Buyer Protection. This is the single easiest route for goods into Portugal.

*Account:* Search works anonymously (the engine bootstraps an anonymous session cookie). An account is only needed to message sellers and buy. Sign up by hand once, then import the session cookie via the Accounts tab.

**2. [Catawiki](https://www.catawiki.com)** — `html` · high confidence · ships to PT

> Pan-EU curated auction house for used collectibles; NL-based, ships EU-wide.

*Shipping:* Sellers quote shipping to PT at checkout.

**2. [Facebook Marketplace](https://www.facebook.com/marketplace)** — `manual` · high confidence · **searched by default** · needs credentials

> By raw volume this is the biggest second-hand venue in most EU countries, especially for furniture and local pickup. But it is strictly local-radius, has no public API, and automated access is an explicit ToS violation that gets accounts banned. Included as a deep link only — the app builds the search URL, you click it.

*Shipping:* Local pickup culture; cross-border almost always needs a private arrangement.

*Account:* Use your existing personal account. Do not automate this one.

**3. [Vestiaire Collective](https://www.vestiairecollective.com)** — `html` · high confidence · ships to PT

> The pan-EU platform for pre-owned designer fashion; authenticates items.

*Shipping:* Centralised authentication hub then onward shipping to PT.

**3. [Back Market](https://www.backmarket.pt)** — `html` · high confidence · ships to PT

> Not peer-to-peer, but the reference EU marketplace for refurbished electronics with a Portuguese storefront and warranty. Worth having in the comparison when the query is a phone/laptop.

*Shipping:* Ships to PT domestically

### Austria (AT)

Currency EUR · shipping zone 3 to Portugal.

**1. [willhaben.at](https://www.willhaben.at)** — `json_api` · high confidence · **searched by default**

> Austria's dominant classifieds site — the local Kleinanzeigen, ~4M+ monthly users in a 9M country.

*Shipping:* willhaben has "Kaufabwicklung" with paid shipping, but Austrian sellers rarely ship outside AT/DE. Route via a DE/AT forwarder or ask the seller to accept a prepaid label you generate (see shipping strategy `prepaid_label`).

**1. [leboncoin](https://www.leboncoin.fr)** — `manual` · high confidence · **searched by default** · ships to PT

> France's #1 general classifieds site by a wide margin and, for non-fashion goods, the single most valuable EU market to search. Downgraded to `manual` on purpose: leboncoin sits behind DataDome, and hammering it from a server gets the IP blocked within minutes. The app emits a deep search link; if you want it automated, drive it with your own logged-in browser session (see docs/02-accounts.md, "browser-session engines").

*Shipping:* leboncoin has integrated "Colis" shipping (Mondial Relay / Colissimo). Cross-border to PT is not offered natively, but France is the strongest corridor for the diaspora-van route — see shipping strategy `diaspora_van`.
